import { type PropertyValues } from 'lit';
import type { PaginationContract } from '@unofficial-krds/contracts';
import { KrdsElement } from '../base.js';
export declare class Pagination extends KrdsElement {
    static properties: {
        page: {
            type: NumberConstructor;
        };
        defaultPage: {
            type: NumberConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        pageCount: {
            type: NumberConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        hrefForPage: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        variant: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        loadMore: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        draft: {
            state: boolean;
        };
        invalid: {
            state: boolean;
        };
    };
    page: number | undefined;
    defaultPage: number | undefined;
    pageCount: number;
    hrefForPage: PaginationContract['hrefForPage'];
    variant: string;
    loadMore: PaginationContract['loadMore'];
    private draft;
    private invalid;
    private state;
    private wasPending;
    private requestedMore;
    private previousShown;
    constructor();
    get committedPage(): number;
    updated(_changed: PropertyValues): void;
    private request;
    private link;
    render(): import("lit").TemplateResult<1>;
}
